{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Correct the case: use 'control' and 'moderate'
filtered_df = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the size of the filtered group
print('Number of control-arm patients with moderate severity:', len(filtered_df))

# Calculate the fraction who responded (responded == 1)
responded_count = filtered_df['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = responded_count / len(filtered_df)

print('Responded count:', responded_count)
print('Fraction responded:', fraction_responded)

# Return the fraction
fraction_responded"}
